The '''Onderon rebels''' were a group of insurgents who mounted an attempt to reclaim [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] from the rule of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]]. Rash had ousted the former King, [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]], and was backed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
[[File:OnderonRebels-FFp44.png|thumb|left|220px|Members of the Onderon rebels]]
After [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|its king]] was replaced with a [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|ruler]] loyal to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with an iron fist. In response, the Onderonion rebellion was formed from a loose group of insurgents hoping to reclaim control of their world and return King Ramsis Dendup to the crown. They received training as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]. They attacked small groups of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], and destroyed the city's power station in an attempt to put all of the droids off-line. The rebels saved their true king, Ramsis Dendup from execution, after which he joined their cause. In their last battle with the separatists, many rebel lives were lost due to the [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|droid gunships]]. [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] also lost her life after she fell off of a cliff to save Dendup from the same fate. Shortly after, Onderon was free again and under Dendup's rule once more.
